# External transaction fixtures

`transaction_vectors.json` contains byte strings and expected values copied
from independent Ethereum specifications and tests, not generated by
`ocaml-evm`:

- the replay-protected legacy transaction and signing hash from the official
  EIP-155 example;
- valid EIP-2930 and EIP-1559 transactions from `ethereum/tests` at commit
  `c67e485ff8b5be9abc8ad15345ec21aa22e290d9`;
- invalid EIP-2930 and EIP-1559 encodings from the same pinned commit.

The fixture records the upstream URL and source path for every value. The
Ethereum tests repository is MIT licensed; EIPs are published under CC0.
Keeping only the selected wire values makes the normal test suite independent
of network access and upstream repository layout.
